sessions.phase_label: Initial page-speed diagnosis and target clarification
South Pointe malware remediation, security hardening, and speed optimization
Oakbridge site restoration and malware remediation

requirements.title: Original Site Page Speed
requirements.definition: Visitor-facing pages at the original site URL should load quickly after diagnosed image, caching, asset, plugin, or infrastructure issues are corrected.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers runtime performance of the original and legacy site experience; RIB is a separately targetable test experience, while image, cache, font, and plugin findings are implementation factors rather than separate Requirements.

requirements.title: RIB Test Experience Page Speed
requirements.definition: The independently evaluated RIB test experience should have acceptable visitor-facing load performance on mobile and desktop.
requirements.boundary_note: RIB is kept separate from the original-site performance Requirement because the client explicitly targeted both and RIB had its own cache and design-related performance findings; mobile and desktop remain contexts of one RIB mechanism.

requirements.title: South Pointe Layout and Formatting Integrity
requirements.definition: South Pointe pages should retain their intended fonts, formatting, and rendered layout when hosting, cache, or optimization changes are applied.
requirements.boundary_note: This is independent of load speed because formatting can regress even when performance improves; Thrive migration decisions are not included unless they become committed.

requirements.title: South Pointe Malware and Backdoor Eradication
requirements.definition: Remove malicious code, fake plugins, backdoors, and replicator files from South Pointe and establish a clean site installation.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers eradication of malicious executable artifacts; spam data deletion, account cleanup, preventive monitoring, and legitimate-plugin updates have independently testable outcomes and remain separate.

requirements.title: South Pointe Authorized Administrator Accounts
requirements.definition: South Pointe administrator access should be restricted to the client-approved accounts, with unauthorized and hidden accounts removed or stripped of access.
requirements.boundary_note: The approved-account allowlist and unauthorized-account removal form one access-control mechanism; credential rotation is separately actionable and is not merged into this Requirement.

requirements.title: South Pointe Malicious Content Cleanup
requirements.definition: Delete malware-generated casino pages, posts, tags, and related unauthorized content while preserving legitimate site content.
requirements.boundary_note: Database content cleanup is distinct from removing executable malware and from removing already indexed spam URLs from external search results.

requirements.title: South Pointe Automated Security Protection
requirements.definition: Configure ongoing automated malware scanning and attack blocking for South Pointe through Wordfence or an equivalent security control.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers ongoing automated detection and blocking, not the one-time eradication of the discovered infection or updates to vulnerable plugins.

requirements.title: South Pointe Vulnerable Plugin Hardening
requirements.definition: Update, replace, remove, or disable outdated, altered, unlicensed, or high-risk South Pointe plugins that could permit reinfection.
requirements.boundary_note: Includes the immediate handling of vulnerable Thrive Apprentice and other risky plugins; a future migration of page-builder content and complete Thrive retirement would be a separate architecture Requirement if firmly accepted.

requirements.title: South Pointe Search-Index Spam Cleanup
requirements.definition: Submit and complete removal of malware-generated South Pointe URLs from search results to prevent continuing search-trust and ranking damage.
requirements.boundary_note: This external search-index cleanup can succeed or fail independently of deleting spam records from WordPress and therefore remains separate.

requirements.title: South Pointe Administrative Credential Rotation
requirements.definition: Rotate WordPress and WP Engine administrative passwords after the security reset so previously exposed credentials no longer grant access.
requirements.boundary_note: Credential rotation is a one-time authentication configuration action distinct from deciding which administrator accounts may continue to exist.

requirements.title: South Pointe Commenting Disabled
requirements.definition: Disable public WordPress commenting because commenting is not used by the South Pointe business site.
requirements.boundary_note: Comment availability can be independently enabled or disabled and is not merely an attribute of malware removal; client acceptance is inferred from the direct response to the unique disablement proposal.

requirements.title: South Pointe Contact Form Delivery
requirements.definition: South Pointe contact-form submissions should continue reaching the intended mailbox after security and optimization changes.
requirements.boundary_note: The messages request testing, but they also state the independently testable underlying product behavior that lead-delivery must continue; the test activity itself is not a separate Requirement.

requirements.title: Oakbridge Page and Layout Restoration
requirements.definition: Restore Oakbridge's legitimate pages, posts, theme rendering, and site layout after malware moved content to Trash and caused blank pages.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers restoration and rendering of legitimate content; deleting injected spam and eradicating malicious code are separate outcomes that can proceed independently.

requirements.title: Oakbridge Malware and Backdoor Eradication
requirements.definition: Remove malicious theme code, backdoors, infected files, and other executable malware from Oakbridge and establish a clean installation.
requirements.boundary_note: Executable malware removal is separated from restoring trashed pages, removing unauthorized accounts, cleaning spam data, and configuring future protection.

requirements.title: Oakbridge Authorized Administrator Accounts
requirements.definition: Retain only the client-authorized Oakbridge administrator account and remove hidden, fake, or otherwise unauthorized users.
requirements.boundary_note: The authorized-account allowlist and hidden-user cleanup form one account-control mechanism; password rotation remains a separate one-time security action.

requirements.title: Oakbridge Malicious Content Cleanup
requirements.definition: Remove malware-generated posts and other unauthorized spam content from Oakbridge while preserving or restoring legitimate pages.
requirements.boundary_note: Injected-content deletion is distinct from restoring legitimate pages and from removing externally indexed spam URLs.

requirements.title: Oakbridge Automated Security Protection
requirements.definition: Configure Wordfence or equivalent automated scanning and attack blocking to protect Oakbridge after cleanup.
requirements.boundary_note: Ongoing monitoring and blocking are independently maintained after one-time malware eradication and therefore form a separate Requirement.

requirements.title: Oakbridge Vulnerable Plugin Hardening
requirements.definition: Clean, update, replace, disable, or remove Oakbridge plugins and theme components whose outdated or altered state presents a security risk.
requirements.boundary_note: Hardening legitimate but vulnerable components is separate from deleting already implanted backdoors and can require future maintenance after the current infection is clean.

requirements.title: Oakbridge Search-Index Spam Cleanup
requirements.definition: Use the Oakbridge Search Console property to submit malware-generated URLs for removal from search results.
requirements.boundary_note: Search Console access is a prerequisite rather than its own Requirement; the independently requested deliverable is removal submission for indexed malicious URLs.

requirements.title: Oakbridge Administrative Credential Rotation
requirements.definition: Change Oakbridge administrative credentials after malware cleanup so potentially exposed passwords no longer provide access.
requirements.boundary_note: Password rotation is an independently executable authentication change and is separate from removing unauthorized user records.

requirements.title: Oakbridge Contact Form Functionality
requirements.definition: Oakbridge contact forms should remain operational after backup restoration and malware cleanup.
requirements.boundary_note: The instruction to test each form reveals an independently testable underlying product behavior; generic testing activity is not modeled as a Requirement.

unresolved_candidates.description: XML-RPC was reported disabled, but the generic client acknowledgement does not safely establish whether this independently configurable restriction became a client-confirmed persistent Requirement.

The history discusses possibly migrating legacy pages to Elementor and later removing Thrive, but it is unclear whether full Thrive retirement was committed or remained a tentative future option; immediate Thrive Apprentice risk mitigation is covered by plugin hardening.
